text:
Marta: Quick sync — proposing a "pin ramp-down" lifecycle: collapse 30d/90d into 60d default + automated, reversible ramp-down for low-touch tenants. Key difference from prior ideas: explicit billing reconciliation step and an "escrow freeze" escape hatch for customers with contracts. Thoughts? :sparkles:

Diego: From runtime: ramp-down OK if we make it deterministic. Suggest conditions: monthly tokens < 120k AND 30d QA pass rate stable. Also recommend a staged traffic taper rather than instant switch to avoid cache storms.

Ava: Ops wants clear observability. Requirements: per-tenant trace IDs, pre/post sample diffs, a short shadow period, and an escrow freeze API that locks a tenant's pin until manual review. Alerts if 99p latency grows >10% or error-rate up >1.5%.

Ken: Operational rollback SLA must be practical. Propose automated rollback ability within 12 minutes + a manual emergency freeze. Also need a small KV cache priming window after ramp-down to smooth regen.

Priya: Product acceptance gates proposal: (1) bench delta <= 2% on top-10 prompt slices in canary, (2) rollback < 12min, (3) escrow freeze UI + opt-out flow available, (4) billing reconciliation doc showing cost delta between pinned and default routing for reserved tenants. I'll own the billing doc.

LegalBot: Contracts note: any language mentioning "pinned version" must be respected. We'll need a signed exception list before enabling automated ramp-down for paying customers. Also need legal-approved comm language for automatic enrollment of SMBs.

Diego: Canary plan sketch:
1) Feature-flag roll-out (off by default)
2) Shadow mode 10 days (no live switching) for 3 internal tenants + 2 low-usage customers
3) Live ramp-down for 7 days with staged taper (90% -> 50% -> 0% pinned traffic over 48h)
4) If metrics OK, enable cohort-B default 60d with opt-out

Example pseudo-config we sketched:```json
{"pin_rampdown":{
  "enabled":true,
  "default_grace_days":60,
  "usage_threshold_tokens_month":120000,
  "shadow_days":10,
  "live_days":7,
  "taper_schedule_hours":"48",
  "rollback_sla_minutes":12,
  "escrow_freeze_flag":true
}}
```

Ava: +1. Add a data capture requirement: store a 500-sample corpus of inputs+outputs pre/post change for automated diffs. Also schedule a KV-priming cron to run every 6h for a week after ramp-down.

Priya: On billing: we must ensure reserved tenants are not auto-billed at pinned rates post-rampdown unless contractually exempt. I'll produce a reconciliation table and a comms FAQ for sales.

Marta: Action items recap: Diego -> implement feature-flag + taper controller + sim harness (owner Diego, due Thu EOD); Ava -> alerts, sample capture, KV-priming job (owner Ava, due Fri); Priya -> billing reconciliation doc + comm FAQ (owner Priya, due Mon); LegalBot -> compile contract exceptions and sign-off wording (owner LegalBot, due Mon). I'll schedule a 25m follow-up next Tue to review shadow metrics.

ops-bot: CI: feature/pin-rampdown -> staging (dry-run) scheduled 2026-04-09T03:00Z.

Marta: Thanks all. If you see any legal or tech blockers call them out now. :raised_hands:
